content: Claude Code compaction: auto-compact fires ~92-95% context utilization (threshold drifted across versions; disable via autoCompactEnabled:false or DISABLE_AUTOCOMPACT). Warning banner near ~60%. Summary covers requests, actions, code changes, decisions, next steps; old tool outputs dropped; system prompt + CLAUDE.md re-injected; recent turns kept verbatim. Microcompact = earlier selective clearing of older tool results (keep last N), largely absorbed into auto-compact in v2.x. /compact manual with optional focus instructions. Community: compaction loses details; users write state to notes or resume fresh.
